nova-card: a card generator; pre-linted briefs from a ledger, a findings file or a tool's help, ready for nova-sprint add --brief-dir
nova-sprint: rework refuses a repeated finding; pro starts on pro; batch everything; a member is overloaded
sprint: reads asked and levelled by room, a reader's width its fleet row's
sprint store: a read set indexes each cell by its smaller side, not every cell times every id
nova-sandbox: the darwin wall grants com.apple.trustd.agent, so Go can verify TLS inside it
nova-sprint land: regenerate or union every ledger conflict, go runs read-only, the tree gate on every tip
nova-swarm: the bench's whole sdk on the walled child's PATH
nova-sprint readers: one judgment for the primaries no reader may be asked; nova-swarm lint: the bare file, a nova-sandbox invocation, the word space
nova-swarm: the push repository holds the staged commit itself; a failed usage read never ends a card
nova-sprint: last night's comfort list, items 1 to 11
nova-swarm: the headless harnesses of the heavy tier (claude, codex, grok)
script step: grant the bench toolchain, not the slot home
nova-bus: the Redis bus is nova-bus; the git bus is removed
